novel_features.name: Brief cite extractor
novel_features.description: List every California case and statute cited in your draft brief (.docx or .txt), de-duplicated.
novel_features.rationale: Reads your own file locally; Lexis+ cannot tell you what a draft cites.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns a draft into a pull list for batch.
novel_features.group: From your brief to your binder

novel_features.name: Brief cite verifier
novel_features.description: Check every citation in a draft against Lexis+ and flag the ones it does not recognize.
novel_features.rationale: Combines local parsing with Lexis citation recognition.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catches mistyped volumes and pages before filing.
novel_features.group: From your brief to your binder

novel_features.name: Brief gaps
novel_features.description: See which cited authorities you have not pulled yet, and which pulled ones the draft no longer cites.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the draft's citations with your local retrieval log.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Shows exactly what is left to download.
novel_features.group: From your brief to your binder

novel_features.name: Matter ledger
novel_features.description: Browse everything you pulled for each matter, with date, format, and file path.
novel_features.rationale: Needs the local retrieval log tagged with --matter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'did we pull the annotated version, and when?'

novel_features.name: Statute annotation diff
novel_features.description: Re-pull an annotated statute and see which annotations were added or removed since your last pull.
novel_features.rationale: Diffs the new Deering's annotations against your saved copy.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Finds new case notes without rereading 40 pages.

novel_features.name: Authority binder
novel_features.description: Copy a matter's files into one ordered folder (cases, then statutes) with an index.csv.
novel_features.rationale: Built from your local retrieval log and saved files.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Binder and index in one command.

novel_features.name: Brief source packet
novel_features.description: Pull the Lexis+ text and Shepard's status for every authority a brief cites, with each pin cite and the text around it, into one folder with a manifest.

novel_features.name: Quote and pin checker
novel_features.description: Check a brief's quotation against the Lexis+ copy: verbatim or not, every un-signaled difference, the official reporter page, and whether the words are the majority's, a concurrence's, a dissent's, or a footnote's.

novel_features.name: Page-marked source text
novel_features.description: Plain text of a case or statute with official reporter page markers and speaker labels; --pages prints only the opinion text on those pages.

narrative.headline: Pull California cases and annotated statutes from your own Lexis+ subscription straight into Word, by citation.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve a citation, download the opinion or the Deering's annotated section as a Word file, and keep a local log of what you pulled. Uses your own logged-in Lexis+ session; no bulk crawling.
narrative.auth_narrative: Lexis+ has no API key. Sign in once with the press-auth companion (press-auth login plus.lexis.com); the CLI reuses that session's cookies and tells you when it expires.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the citation lookup command works

troubleshoots.fix: Session expired: run press-auth login plus.lexis.com --login-url https://signin.lexisnexis.com/lnaccess/app/signin

narrative.when_to_use: Use to retrieve known California authorities by citation and save them as Word files. Not for open-ended research or bulk downloading.
anti_triggers: Open-ended legal research or Shepard's analysis
Bulk or automated harvesting of Lexis content

recipes.title: Pull a case
recipes.explanation: Resolves the citation and saves the opinion as a Word file.

recipes.title: Pull an annotated statute
recipes.explanation: Saves Deering's with annotations as a Word file.

recipes.title: Narrow output
recipes.explanation: Agent-friendly JSON with only the fields you need.

trigger_phrases: download Cal Lab Code 1102.5 with annotations
